answer.rationale: Regional failover has a proven track record (memory_b2) of resolving region-specific latency degradations with clean traffic shifting and rapid error rate recovery within minutes. It directly addresses the current primary-region write path latency issue while respecting the compliance constraint that the security-patched release cannot be reverted. Alternative actions are either infeasible (rollback_release due to compliance), do not address write path latency (route_read_replicas), or are less directly applicable to region-wide degradation (add_capacity, enable_circuit_breaker). Circuit breaker verification (memory_b4) confirms it solves a different class of problem (dependency outage containment) rather than region-specific latency.
